Marissa / Neha —

Thanks for the ping. Below are concise answers you can send to Laura (I’ve attached an executive summary of our latest external assessment).

1) Most recent external penetration test: 2025-11-12 by SecureSphere Labs. Executive summary attached: PenTest-Executive-Summary.pdf. The full report is available under NDA — we ask customers to sign a standard mutual NDA / review agreement; I can route DocuSign if they confirm.

2) Scanning cadence:
   - Continuous SCA/DAST via internal pipelines and 24/7 automated scanning for dependencies.
   - Weekly internal scheduled vulnerability scans (internal infra + container images).
   - Quarterly external penetration tests (standard cadence) and ad-hoc engagements for major releases.

3) Remediation SLA targets (severity-driven):
   - Critical (CVSS 9.0-10.0): initial mitigation within 24-48 hours and a tracked remediation plan; patch or mitigation deployed ASAP, with customer notification within 24 hours of detection for anything impacting customer data.
   - High (7.0-8.9): remediation plan within 7 calendar days, resolution targeted within 30 days depending on complexity.
   - Medium/Low: prioritized per backlog and risk profile; typically triaged and scheduled within 30-90 days.

4) Disclosure and customer notification:
   - For vulnerabilities affecting customer data or tenant isolation we notify impacted customers within 24 hours and provide an interim mitigation plan.
   - We publish CVE advisories for public vulnerabilities and maintain a customer-facing status page for incidents.

5) HIPAA / BAA: Redwood offers Private deployment options that can support HIPAA-covered workloads. We have a standard BAA for Private deployments (on-prem / VPC) and additional controls we can document for HealthCorp’s review. For hosted (shared) deployments we recommend a conversation with legal; we can route to our compliance team.

6) Vendor questionnaire: Please direct them to the vendor questionnaire link (https://redwood.box.com/v/vendor-security-questionnaire). If HealthCorp prefers a completed questionnaire PDF, we can fill a copy after initial NDA.
